resources.string: HTML/SVG rendered in a sandbox, bar/line charts, tables; local rendering, no network, no scripts

Render the HTML or SVG you wrote inside an on-device sandbox: it is sanitized first (scripts, event attributes, iframes, external images/CSS are stripped), then shown in Xuanlan local preview and captured as a PNG. Files land in 图片/, an existing name is never overwritten; empty content, unrecognized markup or oversize input returns a readable error instead of a blank image. It never calls an image model, never goes online and never runs scripts.

Lay out a bar or line chart locally from the JSON data you provide (categories and series names/values) and write an SVG to 图片/; optionally capture a PNG too. Values are never guessed — negative or non-numeric input is an error; at most 8 series and 30 categories. For flowcharts or diagrams use Canvas (HTML/SVG) instead of inventing a format.

Turn a Markdown table, CSV or JSON rows into a copyable HTML table (optionally with a PNG capture), written to 产物/表格/ without overwriting. Cell contents are treated as plain text, so HTML inside a cell is never executed. At most 200 rows and 20 columns.
